en.rules.title: Card rules
en.rules.lead: Rules of the ANT.AI pool edition.
en.rules.1.title: Supply
en.rules.1.body:
Cards: 777,777 total. 738,889 public mints and 38,888 team cards. Each address can mint at most 10. Transfers and burns do not restore the quota.
Tokens: 777,777,777 fixed in the contract. Nothing more can be minted. The whole supply is assigned. There is no reserve, and nobody can move an unassigned balance.
en.rules.2.title: Token allocation
en.rules.2.body:
① Pool liquidity: 124,672,000 tokens (about 16.0%) enter with 36.75 BNB. The LP is burned.
② Presale grants: 20,000 × 8,440 = 168,800,000 tokens (about 21.7%). One fifth is released when the pool opens. The rest vests over five days from the open.
!Team cards are only 5% of all cards (38,888 / 777,777), and they are not released at once: one team card unlocks for every 19 paid mints. Team cards have the same rights as ordinary cards.
③ Ladder sales: 58,611,119 tokens (about 7.5%), sold only after the price rises. The BNB goes entirely to card holders. See Ladder sales below.
④ Burn at open: 97,479,938 tokens (about 12.5%) go to the dead address the moment the pool opens. They leave circulation for good. They do not enter the pool, a listing, or anyone's balance.
What remains after ①–④ is the team-card allocation. It is released card by card on the unlock pace above, not all at once.
Cards minted after the pool opens sit outside this allocation. They buy tokens in the pool with BNB: 10% is burned and 90% vests to the minting address over five days from that mint.
en.rules.3.title: Presale
en.rules.3.body:
The first 20,000 cards cost 0.00245 BNB, 49 BNB in total, over a 7-day window.
Each presale card grants 8,440 tokens. At the moment the pool opens, 1,688 are claimable. The remaining 6,752 vest linearly over five days. Tokens stay with the minting address.
If the presale does not sell out in 7 days, burning a presale card refunds its BNB.
en.rules.4.title: Opening the pool
en.rules.4.body:
The mint that sells the 20,000th card opens the pool in the same transaction: 36.75 BNB and 124,672,000 tokens enter, the LP is burned, and 97,479,938 tokens are transferred to the dead address in the same step.
If the seven-day window ends before sell-out, the pool does not open and a presale card may be burned for a full refund. After sell-out there is no refund.
en.rules.5.title: Mints after the pool
en.rules.5.body:
After the pool opens, each card costs 0.0049 BNB with no further increase. 25% is operations. 75% buys tokens in the pool.
Of the tokens bought, 10% is burned and 90% vests to the minting address over five days from that mint. The amount depends on the pool price at execution.
en.rules.6.title: Ladder sales
en.rules.6.body:
In short: the vault holds tokens that sell in three fixed bands when the price reaches 1.5×, 2× and 3× the opening price. All of the BNB goes to card holders.
Opening price: 36.75 BNB ÷ 124,672,000 tokens, about 0.000000295 BNB each (about 3.39 million tokens per BNB).
Band one: about 19.537 million tokens at 1.5× the open. Band two: about 19.537 million at 2×. Band three: about 19.537 million at 3×.
A band opens only when the 30-minute average price reaches that band. If the price never gets there, none of those tokens sell. The average stops a one-trade spike from triggering a sale.
Anyone can buy an open band from the vault at its fixed price, and the tokens arrive immediately. A band closes when it sells out. The three bands total 58,611,119 tokens and are not refilled.
Once a band is open, the purchase may be below the market price at that moment.
Where the money goes: 100% of the BNB goes to card holders, not operations. It drips into dividends over 7 days, the same amount on every card.
!The higher the price climbs, the more BNB card holders receive from the ladder. If the price does not climb, the ladder does not move.
en.rules.7.title: Trade tax
en.rules.7.body:
Each token trade pays 2%: 50% is an equal dividend per card, 30% fills the floor fund, and 20% is operations.
Dividends sit on the card until claimed. After a transfer, later dividends belong to the new holder.
en.rules.8.title: Floor fund
en.rules.8.body:
What it does: it holds the floor. It buys the cheapest listings one by one and burns the cards, so cheap asks are cleared and the floor cannot be walked down.
Where the money comes from: 30% of the 2% trade tax. It sits in the vault, can only buy cards, and nobody can withdraw it.
A fee reserve comes first: the fund tops up 0.02 BNB. That reserve pays the automation fee and is never used to buy cards.
When it buys: once every 30 minutes, and anyone can trigger a run.
How it buys: upward from the lowest ask. While the price is under the cap and the fund can pay, it buys the listing in full. At the same price, presale and team cards come before post-pool cards.
What the seller receives: the list price plus the dividend accrued on that card, settled immediately.
The card is burned: it is gone, supply shrinks, and the cards that remain are scarcer.
Caps: 0.00245 BNB for presale and team cards, 0.0049 BNB for post-pool cards. Asks above the cap are skipped.
Extra burn: when a post-pool card is bought, only tokens that are still locked burn. Tokens already unlocked stay with the holder even if they have not been claimed. Tokens already claimed stay with the previous holder. Presale and team-card tokens are not touched.
When it stops: the next ask is above the fund balance, or above 0.0049 BNB. That round ends and waits for the next one.
!More trading fills the fund, cheap asks clear faster, more cards burn, and the floor rises. The money comes from the market itself.
en.rules.9.title: Team cards
en.rules.9.body: One team card activates for every 19 paid mints, 38,888 in total, inside the supply. Team cards have the same rights as ordinary cards.
en.rules.10.title: How to mint
en.rules.10.body:
Mints are sent from the Binance Agent Wallet after you confirm them. This site does not sign or broadcast for you.
Prices move. The project does not promise a fixed return.
en.rules.11.title: Constraints on sell pressure
en.rules.11.body:
Sell pressure of this kind usually comes from three unconstrained sources: an insider balance that can be transferred at will, liquidity that can be withdrawn, and a discounted allocation that enters circulation at the open. The model addresses each of them.
!The team does not hold a separate token balance. Its interest takes the form of cards: one card unlocks for every 19 paid mints, with the same rights as ordinary cards. Team cards are 5% of all cards.
The liquidity position is burned when the pool opens and cannot be withdrawn.
In the same transaction, 97,479,938 tokens are transferred to the dead address. They do not enter any balance.
Of the tokens corresponding to the presale, one fifth is released when the pool opens. The rest vests over five days from the open.
Mints after the open do not create supply without consideration. Seventy-five percent of the amount paid buys tokens from the pool. Of the tokens bought, 10% is burned immediately and 90% vests over five days from that mint.
The only prearranged sale is the ladder. A fixed quantity is sold only when the 30-minute average reaches 1.5×, 2×, or 3× the opening price. Below those levels, nothing is sold. Proceeds are credited entirely to card holders, and that inventory cannot be transferred in advance.
Tokens that have completed vesting remain transferable, and the price remains subject to the market. The arrangements above exclude an insider balance, withdrawable liquidity, and supply created without consideration.

卡牌：共 777,777 张。738,889 张公开铸造，38,888 张团队卡。每个地址最多铸造 10 张，转让或销毁不恢复名额。
代币：总量固定 777,777,777 枚，合约写死，不能增发。全部分配完毕，没有预留额度，也没有任何人可以动用。
en.l.en.rules.2.title: Token allocation
en.l.zh.rules.2.title: 代币分配
en.l.en.rules.2.body:
① Pool liquidity: 124,672,000 tokens (about 16.0%) enter with 36.75 BNB. The LP is burned.
② Presale grants: 20,000 × 8,440 = 168,800,000 tokens (about 21.7%). One fifth is released when the pool opens. The rest vests over five days from the open.
!Team cards are only 5% of all cards (38,888 / 777,777), and they are not released at once: one team card unlocks for every 19 paid mints. Team cards have the same rights as ordinary cards.
③ Ladder sales: 58,611,119 tokens (about 7.5%), sold only after the price rises. The BNB goes entirely to card holders. See Ladder sales below.
④ Burn at open: 97,479,938 tokens (about 12.5%) go to the dead address the moment the pool opens. They leave circulation for good. They do not enter the pool, a listing, or anyone's balance.
What remains after ①–④ is the team-card allocation. It is released card by card on the unlock pace above, not all at once.
Cards minted after the pool opens sit outside this allocation. They buy tokens in the pool with BNB: 10% is burned and 90% vests to the minting address over five days from that mint.
en.l.zh.rules.2.body:
① 开池流动性：124,672,000 枚（约 16.0%），与 36.75 BNB 一起进池子，LP 直接销毁。
② 预售卡发放：20,000 张 × 8,440 = 168,800,000 枚（约 21.7%）。开池当时释放五分之一，其余自开池起五日释放。
!团队卡只占全部卡牌的 5%（38,888 / 777,777），而且不能一次放出：每铸出 19 张付费卡，才解锁 1 张团队卡。团队卡与普通卡同权。
③ 阶梯卖单：58,611,119 枚（约 7.5%），只在币价涨上去之后才卖，卖币得到的 BNB 全部分给持卡人。具体怎么运作见下面「阶梯卖单」一节。
④ 开池时销毁：97,479,938 枚（约 12.5%），开池那一刻直接打进黑洞地址，永久退出流通，不进入池子、不挂单、不计入任何人名下。
①–④ 之外剩下的部分对应团队卡，按上面的解锁节奏逐张放出，不会一次性进入流通。
开池后铸造的卡不占以上额度：它们用 BNB 当场在池子里买币，10% 销毁，90% 自该笔铸造起五日释放给铸造地址。
en.l.en.rules.3.title: Presale
en.l.zh.rules.3.title: 预售
en.l.en.rules.3.body:
Listings and bids stay closed during the presale and open only after the pool opens.
The first 20,000 cards cost 0.00245 BNB, 49 BNB in total, over a 7-day window.
Each presale card grants 8,440 tokens. At the moment the pool opens, 1,688 are claimable. The remaining 6,752 vest linearly over five days. Tokens stay with the minting address.
If the presale does not sell out in 7 days, burning a presale card refunds its BNB.
en.l.zh.rules.3.body:
预售期间不可以挂单。卖单和买单都要等开池以后。
前 20,000 张为预售，每张 0.00245 BNB，合计 49 BNB。预售窗口 7 天。
每张预售卡对应 8,440 枚。开池当时可领取 1,688 枚，其余 6,752 枚自开池起五日线性释放。代币记在铸造地址名下，不随卡牌转移。
7 天内没卖满，可销毁预售卡，全额退回 BNB。
en.l.en.rules.4.title: Opening the pool
en.l.zh.rules.4.title: 开池
en.l.en.rules.4.body:
NFT duels open only after all 20,000 presale cards sell out and the pool opens.
The mint that sells the 20,000th card opens the pool in the same transaction: 36.75 BNB and 124,672,000 tokens enter, the LP is burned, and 97,479,938 tokens are transferred to the dead address in the same step.
If the seven-day window ends before sell-out, the pool does not open and a presale card may be burned for a full refund. After sell-out there is no refund.
en.l.zh.rules.4.body:
NFT 对决要等预售卖满 20,000 张、开池以后才能参加。
售出第 20,000 张的同一笔交易开池：36.75 BNB 与 124,672,000 枚进入池子，流动性凭证销毁，同一步骤将 97,479,938 枚转入黑洞地址。
七日窗口结束时仍未售罄，开池不再进行，预售卡可销毁并全额退款。售罄之后不再退款。
en.l.en.rules.5.title: Mints after the pool
en.l.zh.rules.5.title: 开池后铸造
en.l.en.rules.5.body:
After the pool opens, each card costs 0.0049 BNB with no further increase. 25% is operations. 75% buys tokens in the pool.
Of the tokens bought, 10% is burned and 90% vests to the minting address over five days from that mint. The amount depends on the pool price at execution.
en.l.zh.rules.5.body:
开池后每张 0.0049 BNB，此后不再上调。25% 为运营费用，75% 当场在池中购入代币。
购得部分的 10% 立即销毁，90% 记在铸造地址名下，自该笔铸造起五日线性释放。到手数量按成交时池子价格决定。
en.l.en.rules.6.title: Ladder sales
en.l.zh.rules.6.title: 阶梯卖单
en.l.en.rules.6.body:
In short: the vault holds tokens that sell in three fixed bands when the price reaches 1.5×, 2× and 3× the opening price. All of the BNB goes to card holders.
Opening price: 36.75 BNB ÷ 124,672,000 tokens, about 0.000000295 BNB each (about 3.39 million tokens per BNB).
Band one: about 19.537 million tokens at 1.5× the open. Band two: about 19.537 million at 2×. Band three: about 19.537 million at 3×.
A band opens only when the 30-minute average price reaches that band. If the price never gets there, none of those tokens sell. The average stops a one-trade spike from triggering a sale.
Anyone can buy an open band from the vault at its fixed price, and the tokens arrive immediately. A band closes when it sells out. The three bands total 58,611,119 tokens and are not refilled.
Once a band is open, the purchase may be below the market price at that moment.
Where the money goes: 100% of the BNB goes to card holders, not operations. It drips into dividends over 7 days, the same amount on every card.
!The higher the price climbs, the more BNB card holders receive from the ladder. If the price does not climb, the ladder does not move.
en.l.zh.rules.6.body:
一句话：金库里留了一批币，等币价涨到开盘价的 1.5 倍、2 倍、3 倍时，分三档按固定价格卖出，卖得的 BNB 全部分给持卡人。
开盘价：36.75 BNB ÷ 124,672,000 枚，约每枚 0.000000295 BNB（即 1 BNB 约买 339 万枚）。
第一档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 1.5。第二档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 2。第三档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 3。
什么时候能买：只有当最近 30 分钟的平均币价达到或超过这一档价格时，这一档才开放。币价没涨到，这批币一枚都不会卖出，不会砸盘。用平均价是为了防止有人瞬间拉价格来触发。
谁来买：任何人都可以按这一档的固定价格直接从金库买，买到的币当场到账。每档卖完即关闭，三档总量就是 58,611,119 枚，卖完不再补充。
档位开放后，有可能以低于当时市价的价格买入。
钱去哪：卖币收到的 BNB 100% 给持卡人，不进运营。这笔 BNB 分 7 天匀速放进分红，每张卡分到一样多。
!简单说：币价涨得越高，持卡人从阶梯卖单拿到的 BNB 分红越多；币价不涨，阶梯卖单就不动。
en.l.en.rules.7.title: Trade tax
en.l.zh.rules.7.title: 交易税
en.l.en.rules.7.body:
Each token trade pays 2%: 50% is an equal dividend per card, 30% fills the floor fund, and 20% is operations.
Dividends sit on the card until claimed. After a transfer, later dividends belong to the new holder.
en.l.zh.rules.7.body:
代币每笔交易收 2% 税：50% 按卡等权分红，30% 进入地板基金，20% 为运营费用。
分红记在卡上，需主动领取。卡牌转让后，后续分红归新持有人。
en.l.en.rules.8.title: Floor fund
en.l.zh.rules.8.title: 地板基金
en.l.en.rules.8.body:
What it does: it holds the floor. It buys the cheapest listings one by one and burns the cards, so cheap asks are cleared and the floor cannot be walked down.
Where the money comes from: 30% of the 2% trade tax. It sits in the vault, can only buy cards, and nobody can withdraw it.
A fee reserve comes first: the fund tops up 0.02 BNB. That reserve pays the automation fee and is never used to buy cards.
When it buys: once every 30 minutes, and anyone can trigger a run.
How it buys: upward from the lowest ask. While the price is under the cap and the fund can pay, it buys the listing in full. At the same price, presale and team cards come before post-pool cards.
What the seller receives: the list price plus the dividend accrued on that card, settled immediately.
The card is burned: it is gone, supply shrinks, and the cards that remain are scarcer.
Caps: 0.00245 BNB for presale and team cards, 0.0049 BNB for post-pool cards. Asks above the cap are skipped.
Extra burn: when a post-pool card is bought, only tokens that are still locked burn. Tokens already unlocked stay with the holder even if they have not been claimed. Tokens already claimed stay with the previous holder. Presale and team-card tokens are not touched.
When it stops: the next ask is above the fund balance, or above 0.0049 BNB. That round ends and waits for the next one.
!More trading fills the fund, cheap asks clear faster, more cards burn, and the floor rises. The money comes from the market itself.
en.l.zh.rules.8.body:
它是干什么的：托底。市场上最便宜的卖单被它一张一张买走并销毁，低价单被清空、卡被烧掉，地板价就被抬住，想砸盘也砸不穿。
钱从哪来：每笔交易 2% 税里的 30% 进地板基金，记在金库合约里，只用来买卡，任何人都取不走。
先留一笔执行费：基金先补足 0.02 BNB 的触发储备，这笔钱只付自动化服务的手续费，绝不用于买卡。
什么时候买：每 30 分钟自动跑一次，任何人也可以手动触发一次。
怎么买：从市场最低挂单往上排，一路买过去。只要挂价在封顶线以内、基金余额够，就按卖家挂的价格全额买下；同一价位上，预售卡和团队卡优先，然后才是开池后铸造的卡。
卖家拿到多少：挂单价 + 这张卡到目前为止累积的分红，一分不少，当场结清。
买到的卡直接销毁：卡永久消失，总供应量变少，剩下的卡更稀缺。
封顶线：预售卡和团队卡最高 0.00245 BNB，开池后铸造的卡最高 0.0049 BNB。挂价高于封顶线的单不接。
顺带销毁：开池后铸造的卡被买走时，只销毁还锁着的代币。已经解锁、只是还没领的，留在持有人手里。已经领走的也不动。预售卡和团队卡的代币不动。
什么时候停：下一档价格超过基金余额，或者超过 0.0049 BNB，这一轮就停，等下一轮。
!简单说：交易越多，基金越有钱，低价单清得越快，卡烧得越多，地板就越高。托底的钱来自市场本身，不靠任何人掏腰包。
en.l.en.rules.9.title: Team cards
en.l.zh.rules.9.title: 团队卡
en.l.en.rules.9.body: One team card activates for every 19 paid mints, 38,888 in total, inside the supply. Team cards have the same rights as ordinary cards.
en.l.zh.rules.9.body: 每铸造 19 张付费卡，激活 1 张团队卡，共 38,888 张，包含在总量内。团队卡与普通卡同权，没有额外权益。
en.l.en.rules.10.title: How to mint
en.l.zh.rules.10.title: 铸造方式
en.l.en.rules.10.body:
Mints are sent from the Binance Agent Wallet after you confirm them. This site does not sign or broadcast for you.
Prices move. The project does not promise a fixed return.
en.l.en.rules.11.title: Constraints on sell pressure
en.l.en.rules.11.body:
Sell pressure of this kind usually comes from three unconstrained sources: an insider balance that can be transferred at will, liquidity that can be withdrawn, and a discounted allocation that enters circulation at the open. The model addresses each of them.
!The team does not hold a separate token balance. Its interest takes the form of cards: one card unlocks for every 19 paid mints, with the same rights as ordinary cards. Team cards are 5% of all cards.
The liquidity position is burned when the pool opens and cannot be withdrawn.
In the same transaction, 97,479,938 tokens are transferred to the dead address. They do not enter any balance.
Of the tokens corresponding to the presale, one fifth is released when the pool opens. The rest vests over five days from the open.
Mints after the open do not create supply without consideration. Seventy-five percent of the amount paid buys tokens from the pool. Of the tokens bought, 10% is burned immediately and 90% vests over five days from that mint.
The only prearranged sale is the ladder. A fixed quantity is sold only when the 30-minute average reaches 1.5×, 2×, or 3× the opening price. Below those levels, nothing is sold. Proceeds are credited entirely to card holders, and that inventory cannot be transferred in advance.
Tokens that have completed vesting remain transferable, and the price remains subject to the market. The arrangements above exclude an insider balance, withdrawable liquidity, and supply created without consideration.
en.l.zh.rules.10.body:
铸造通过币安 Agent 钱包发起，由你在钱包里确认后执行。网站不代你签名，也不代发交易。
数字资产价格会波动，项目不承诺任何固定收益。
en.l.zh.rules.11.title: 抛压约束
en.l.zh.rules.11.body:
此类抛压通常来自三处未加约束的供给：可自由转让的内部余额、可撤回的流动性，以及开盘即进入流通的折价份额。本模型对三者分别作了安排。
!团队不持有独立的代币余额。团队权益以卡牌形式存在，每完成 19 张付费铸造解锁 1 张，与普通卡同权。团队卡占全部卡牌的 5%。
开池时流动性凭证予以销毁，流动性不可撤回。
同一笔交易将 97,479,938 枚转入黑洞地址，该部分不进入任何地址余额。
预售对应代币于开池当时释放五分之一，其余部分自开池起五日释放。
开池之后的铸造不形成无对价供给。所付金额的 75% 用于在池中购入代币；购得部分的 10% 立即销毁，90% 自该笔铸造起按五日线性释放。
唯一预先安排的出售为阶梯卖单。仅当三十分钟均价达到开盘价的 1.5 倍、2 倍或 3 倍时，按既定数量成交；未达相应价格则不出售。所得计价资产全部计入持卡人分红，该库存不可提前转出。
已完成释放的代币仍可由持有人转让，价格仍随市场变动。上述安排所排除的，是内部余额、可撤回的流动性，以及无对价形成的供给。

You are my Binance wallet assistant. Network: BNB Chain, chainId 56.
This is read-only. Do not send a transaction. The Agent ID contract is {agent}. Call balanceOf(address) with my wallet address to see whether I hold an Agent ID. Encode that inputData yourself from the address. Do not look up an ABI. Then read the cards contract {cards}: launched() for whether the pool is open, paidMinted() for how many cards have been minted, and presaleDeadline() for when the presale ends. Those three inputData values are already encoded. Do not rebuild them. If an address is MISSING, stop.
Check Developer Mode, then read my wallet address and replace 0xYourAgentWallet with it. Preview only and show me the result. Do not execute.
baw wallet settings --json
baw wallet address --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {agent} --value 0 --inputData <ABI-encode balanceOf(address) for the wallet address just returned> --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataLaunched} --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataPaid} --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataDeadline} --json
Do not run contract-call execute.

en.l.en.cmd.sync.title: Sync tax
en.l.en.cmd.sync.desc: Indexes unrecognized tax as 50% dividend, 30% floor, and 20% operations. No batch condition.
en.l.en.cmd.sync.text:
You are my Binance Agent Wallet assistant. Network: BNB Chain, chainId=56. Cards: [cards]. Vault: [vault]. If an address is still a bracket placeholder, stop and do not call another contract. The contract source is not verified. Use the function signatures written below. Do not look up the ABI. Read first. Show the function, arguments, BNB value and gas, and send only after I confirm. Stop on failure. Never ask for or export a private key.
Call function sync() on Vault. Read unrecognizedTax() first and tell me the amount. sync indexes it as 50% dividend, 30% floor, and 20% operations. value is 0. There is no batch and no seven-day wait.
en.l.en.cmd.sync.short:
You are my Binance Agent Wallet assistant. Network: BNB Chain (chainId=56). Cards: [cards]. Vault: [vault]. If an address is still a bracket placeholder, stop. Do not call another contract. Call the functions below directly. Do not look up the ABI.
function unrecognizedTax() view returns (uint256). Contract: Vault. value: 0. Read only. Tell me this amount.
function sync(). Contract: Vault. value: 0. It indexes that tax as 50% dividend, 30% floor, and 20% operations. There is no batch. Show the preview and send only after I confirm.

en.cmd.wallet.title: Check my wallet
en.cmd.wallet.desc: Read-only: Agent ID, cards held, and mint slots left out of 10.
en.cmd.wallet.text:
You are my Binance wallet assistant. Network: BNB Chain, chainId 56.
This is read-only. Do not send a transaction. The Agent ID contract is {agent}. Call balanceOf(address) with my wallet address to see whether I hold an Agent ID. Encode that inputData yourself from the address. Do not look up an ABI. Then read the cards contract {cards}: launched() for whether the pool is open, paidMinted() for how many cards have been minted, and presaleDeadline() for when the presale ends. Those three inputData values are already encoded. Do not rebuild them. If an address is MISSING, stop.
Check Developer Mode, then read my wallet address and replace 0xYourAgentWallet with it. Preview only and show me the result. Do not execute.
baw wallet settings --json
baw wallet address --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {agent} --value 0 --inputData <ABI-encode balanceOf(address) for the wallet address just returned> --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataLaunched} --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataPaid} --json

en.l.zh.ladder.title: 阶梯卖单
en.l.zh.ladder.lead: 金库按开盘价的固定倍数，出售预先留存的代币。
en.l.zh.ladder.wallet: 任意地址支付 BNB 即可，不要求持有卡牌。Agent ID 仅用于铸造卡牌。使用 Agent 钱包时，复制本页指令。
en.l.zh.ladder.unlaunched: 池子尚未打开，暂不可购买。
en.ladder.explain:
The vault holds 58,611,119 tokens in three bands. Each price is fixed at the open — 1.5×, 2× and 3× the opening price — and does not change afterward.
A band can be bought only when the average price of the last 30 minutes has reached that band. Below it, none of the band is sold.
Payment is made in BNB at the band's fixed price. Once a band is open, the purchase may be below the market price at that moment. The tokens are credited to the paying address at once. All of the BNB is credited to card holders and released over seven days. None of it is taken as an operations fee.
One purchase covers a single band. An address may buy the entire remainder of that band. The amount cannot exceed what the band still holds. The band closes when it is sold out and is not refilled.
The purchase does not require a card. An Agent ID is required only when minting a card. A connected wallet uses the button on this page. An Agent wallet uses the command below.

en.l.zh.ladder.explain:
金库留有 58,611,119 枚，分成三档出售。价格在开池时写定，分别为开盘价的 1.5 倍、2 倍和 3 倍，此后不再变动。
某一档能否购买，只看最近三十分钟的平均价格。平均价格达到该档，该档才开放；未达到，则该档一枚也不出售。
购买以 BNB 按该档的固定价格支付。档位开放后，有可能以低于当时市价的价格买入。代币立即记入付款地址。收到的 BNB 全部计入持卡人分红，分七日释放，不计入运营费用。
一次购买只对应一档。同一地址可以买下该档的全部剩余，但不得超过该档尚余的数量。该档售罄后关闭，不再补充。
购买不要求持有卡牌。Agent ID 仅在铸造卡牌时需要。已连接的钱包使用本页按钮。使用 Agent 钱包时，复制下面的指令。

en.duel.1.title: Rooms
en.l.en.duel.1.title: Rooms
en.l.zh.duel.1.title: 房间
en.duel.1.body: There are 100 rooms, numbered 1 to 100. An empty room waits. A room that already has a card starts the match. One address cannot occupy two rooms, or play both sides of the same room. Once a match starts, the room is free again.
en.l.en.duel.1.body: There are 100 rooms, numbered 1 to 100. An empty room waits. A room that already has a card starts the match. One address cannot occupy two rooms, or play both sides of the same room. Once a match starts, the room is free again.

en.duel.2.title: Result
en.l.en.duel.2.title: Result
en.l.zh.duel.2.title: 开奖
en.duel.2.body:
The result is drawn about 60 seconds after both cards are seated. The draw is fair. It uses the already sealed hash of the previous block. Each side has an equal chance, and a participant cannot influence it. It is not shown before then. The winner receives both cards. Wins are recorded on the card that fought, and they remain if the card is transferred.
If one hour passes after the match starts and there is still no winner, both cards return to their holders and the match does not count.

en.l.zh.duel.2.body:
双方入座后约 60 秒开奖。开奖采用公平随机，取已封存的前一区块哈希，双方胜率相等，参与者无法干预。开奖前不公布胜负。胜者获得两张卡。胜次记在出战的卡上，卡牌转让后仍然保留。
开打满 1 小时仍没有赢家，两张卡退回原持有人，该场不计入胜次。
en.duel.3.title: The sixth win
en.l.en.duel.3.title: The sixth win
en.l.zh.duel.3.title: 第六胜
en.duel.3.body:
After a card has won five times, the next win burns the card just taken. The winner's own card is returned, and that card's win count returns to zero.
If the burned card was minted after the pool opened, only the tokens that are still locked are burned. Tokens already unlocked stay with the holder even if they have not been claimed. Tokens already claimed are unaffected.

en.l.zh.duel.3.body:
同一张卡累计获胜五次后，下一次获胜时，刚赢得的卡予以销毁，己方卡牌退回，该卡胜次归零。
若被销毁的是开池后铸造的卡，只销毁还锁着的代币。已经解锁、只是还没领的，留在持有人手里。已经领取的不受影响。
en.duel.4.title: Fee and withdrawal
en.l.en.duel.4.title: Fee and withdrawal
en.l.zh.duel.4.title: 费用与退出
en.duel.4.body:
The drawing fee is 0.0002 BNB, paid to Flap as an infrastructure fee. Entry requires exactly half, 0.0001 BNB. When a match starts, both deposits are returned if the vault's 0.1 BNB balance covers the drawing fee. Otherwise the deposits pay the fee.
Cancelling a wait returns the card, the deposit, and any dividend accrued while waiting. A match that has started cannot be cancelled.

en.duel.cmdText:
You are my Binance wallet assistant. Network: BNB Chain, chainId 56.
Enter a duel. The room is {roomId}. This room is already chosen. If nobody is waiting it is any empty room. Do not change it to room 1 and do not pick another room. An empty room pays half the current fee. A room with someone waiting pays the remainder. Pay {value} wei. First call approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) on the cards contract {cards}. Approve the duel contract {duel}. value wei is 0. Then call enter(uint256 roomId, uint256 tokenId) on the duel contract. Wait until I give the card number. Until then inputData is STOP_NEED_TOKEN. Do not preview it. If {value} is STOP_NO_FEE, the fee is not loaded or the pool is not open. Stop. If an address is MISSING, stop. Do not look up an ABI. Encode these two function signatures.
Check Developer Mode, then read my wallet address and replace 0xYourAgentWallet with it. Preview first and show me parsedTx, simulationResult, risks and authorityChanges. Execute only after I reply yes.
baw wallet settings --json
baw wallet address --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData STOP_NEED_TOKEN --json
baw wallet settings --json
baw wallet address --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {duel} --value {value} --inputData STOP_NEED_TOKEN --json
baw contract-call execute --requestId <requestId> --json

en.cmd.refund.text:
You are the Binance wallet panel. Network: BNB Chain, chainId 56. Use the wallet already selected in this panel. Do not ask me for a wallet name or for tokenIds.
Refund the MINT.AI presale now. The cards contract is {cards}. It is the ERC721 named MINT.AI. The pool never opened, so these cards cannot have been transferred.
Do all of this in this one message. First read every tokenId this wallet holds on that contract. Use this wallet's NFT holdings in the panel. If the holdings list does not show them, read PaidMint events on that contract where minter is this wallet and take the tokenId from each event.
As soon as you have the tokenIds, encode refund(uint256[] tokenIds) with value 0. At most 250 cards in this call. Show only the confirmation card. Broadcast only after I tap execute. If this wallet holds none, say so. Do not ask me to supply tokenIds.
This panel has no baw commands. Do not run baw, do not write an inputData placeholder, and do not stop to wait for parameters.

en.duel.depositNote:
The drawing fee is 0.0002 BNB, paid to Flap as an infrastructure fee. The deposit is half of it, 0.0001 BNB, and must match exactly or entry does not proceed.
When a match starts, both deposits are returned if the vault's 0.1 BNB balance covers the drawing fee. Otherwise the deposits pay the fee.
The draw is fair. It uses the already sealed hash of the previous block. Each side has an equal chance, and a participant cannot influence it.
A waiting player may cancel and recover the card and the deposit. A match that has started cannot be cancelled.

en.l.zh.duel.depositNote:
开奖费为 0.0002 BNB，付给 Flap，作为基础设施费用。已付押金为其一半，即 0.0001 BNB，金额必须一致，否则无法入座。
对决开始时，若金库 0.1 BNB 的余额足以支付开奖费，双方押金退回；否则押金用于支付开奖费。
开奖采用公平随机，取已封存的前一区块哈希，双方胜率相等，参与者无法干预。
等待可以取消，卡牌与押金一并退回。对决开始后不可取消。

zh.rules.title: 卡牌规则
zh.rules.lead: 依据 ANT.AI 开池版合约。
zh.rules.1.title: 发行总量
zh.rules.1.body:
卡牌：共 777,777 张。738,889 张公开铸造，38,888 张团队卡。每个地址最多铸造 10 张，转让或销毁不恢复名额。
代币：总量固定 777,777,777 枚，合约写死，不能增发。全部分配完毕，没有预留额度，也没有任何人可以动用。
zh.rules.2.title: 代币分配
zh.rules.2.body:
① 开池流动性：124,672,000 枚（约 16.0%），与 36.75 BNB 一起进池子，LP 直接销毁。
② 预售卡发放：20,000 张 × 8,440 = 168,800,000 枚（约 21.7%）。开池当时释放五分之一，其余自开池起五日释放。
!团队卡只占全部卡牌的 5%（38,888 / 777,777），而且不能一次放出：每铸出 19 张付费卡，才解锁 1 张团队卡。团队卡与普通卡同权。
③ 阶梯卖单：58,611,119 枚（约 7.5%），只在币价涨上去之后才卖，卖币得到的 BNB 全部分给持卡人。具体怎么运作见下面「阶梯卖单」一节。
④ 开池时销毁：97,479,938 枚（约 12.5%），开池那一刻直接打进黑洞地址，永久退出流通，不进入池子、不挂单、不计入任何人名下。
①–④ 之外剩下的部分对应团队卡，按上面的解锁节奏逐张放出，不会一次性进入流通。
开池后铸造的卡不占以上额度：它们用 BNB 当场在池子里买币，10% 销毁，90% 自该笔铸造起五日释放给铸造地址。
zh.rules.3.title: 预售
zh.rules.3.body:
前 20,000 张为预售，每张 0.00245 BNB，合计 49 BNB。预售窗口 7 天。
每张预售卡对应 8,440 枚。开池当时可领取 1,688 枚，其余 6,752 枚自开池起五日线性释放。代币记在铸造地址名下，不随卡牌转移。
7 天内没卖满，可销毁预售卡，全额退回 BNB。
zh.rules.4.title: 开池
zh.rules.4.body:
售出第 20,000 张的同一笔交易开池：36.75 BNB 与 124,672,000 枚进入池子，流动性凭证销毁，同一步骤将 97,479,938 枚转入黑洞地址。
七日窗口结束时仍未售罄，开池不再进行，预售卡可销毁并全额退款。售罄之后不再退款。
zh.rules.5.title: 开池后铸造
zh.rules.5.body:
开池后每张 0.0049 BNB，此后不再上调。25% 为运营费用，75% 当场在池中购入代币。
购得部分的 10% 立即销毁，90% 记在铸造地址名下，自该笔铸造起五日线性释放。到手数量按成交时池子价格决定。
zh.rules.6.title: 阶梯卖单
zh.rules.6.body:
一句话：金库里留了一批币，等币价涨到开盘价的 1.5 倍、2 倍、3 倍时，分三档按固定价格卖出，卖得的 BNB 全部分给持卡人。
开盘价：36.75 BNB ÷ 124,672,000 枚，约每枚 0.000000295 BNB（即 1 BNB 约买 339 万枚）。
第一档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 1.5。第二档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 2。第三档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 3。
什么时候能买：只有当最近 30 分钟的平均币价达到或超过这一档价格时，这一档才开放。币价没涨到，这批币一枚都不会卖出，不会砸盘。用平均价是为了防止有人瞬间拉价格来触发。
谁来买：任何人都可以按这一档的固定价格直接从金库买，买到的币当场到账。每档卖完即关闭，三档总量就是 58,611,119 枚，卖完不再补充。
档位开放后，有可能以低于当时市价的价格买入。
钱去哪：卖币收到的 BNB 100% 给持卡人，不进运营。这笔 BNB 分 7 天匀速放进分红，每张卡分到一样多。
!简单说：币价涨得越高，持卡人从阶梯卖单拿到的 BNB 分红越多；币价不涨，阶梯卖单就不动。
zh.rules.7.title: 交易税
zh.rules.7.body:
代币每笔交易收 2% 税：50% 按卡等权分红，30% 进入地板基金，20% 为运营费用。
分红记在卡上，需主动领取。卡牌转让后，后续分红归新持有人。
zh.rules.8.title: 地板基金
zh.rules.8.body:
它是干什么的：托底。市场上最便宜的卖单被它一张一张买走并销毁，低价单被清空、卡被烧掉，地板价就被抬住，想砸盘也砸不穿。
钱从哪来：每笔交易 2% 税里的 30% 进地板基金，记在金库合约里，只用来买卡，任何人都取不走。
先留一笔执行费：基金先补足 0.02 BNB 的触发储备，这笔钱只付自动化服务的手续费，绝不用于买卡。
什么时候买：每 30 分钟自动跑一次，任何人也可以手动触发一次。
怎么买：从市场最低挂单往上排，一路买过去。只要挂价在封顶线以内、基金余额够，就按卖家挂的价格全额买下；同一价位上，预售卡和团队卡优先，然后才是开池后铸造的卡。
卖家拿到多少：挂单价 + 这张卡到目前为止累积的分红，一分不少，当场结清。
买到的卡直接销毁：卡永久消失，总供应量变少，剩下的卡更稀缺。
封顶线：预售卡和团队卡最高 0.00245 BNB，开池后铸造的卡最高 0.0049 BNB。挂价高于封顶线的单不接。
顺带销毁：开池后铸造的卡被买走时，只销毁还锁着的代币。已经解锁、只是还没领的，留在持有人手里。已经领走的也不动。预售卡和团队卡的代币不动。
什么时候停：下一档价格超过基金余额，或者超过 0.0049 BNB，这一轮就停，等下一轮。
!简单说：交易越多，基金越有钱，低价单清得越快，卡烧得越多，地板就越高。托底的钱来自市场本身，不靠任何人掏腰包。
zh.rules.9.title: 团队卡
zh.rules.9.body: 每铸造 19 张付费卡，激活 1 张团队卡，共 38,888 张，包含在总量内。团队卡与普通卡同权，没有额外权益。
zh.rules.10.title: 铸造方式
zh.rules.10.body:
铸造通过币安 Agent 钱包发起，由你在钱包里确认后执行。网站不代你签名，也不代发交易。
数字资产价格会波动，项目不承诺任何固定收益。
zh.rules.11.title: 抛压约束
zh.rules.11.body:
此类抛压通常来自三处未加约束的供给：可自由转让的内部余额、可撤回的流动性，以及开盘即进入流通的折价份额。本模型对三者分别作了安排。
!团队不持有独立的代币余额。团队权益以卡牌形式存在，每完成 19 张付费铸造解锁 1 张，与普通卡同权。团队卡占全部卡牌的 5%。
开池时流动性凭证予以销毁，流动性不可撤回。
同一笔交易将 97,479,938 枚转入黑洞地址，该部分不进入任何地址余额。
预售对应代币于开池当时释放五分之一，其余部分自开池起五日释放。
开池之后的铸造不形成无对价供给。所付金额的 75% 用于在池中购入代币；购得部分的 10% 立即销毁，90% 自该笔铸造起按五日线性释放。
唯一预先安排的出售为阶梯卖单。仅当三十分钟均价达到开盘价的 1.5 倍、2 倍或 3 倍时，按既定数量成交；未达相应价格则不出售。所得计价资产全部计入持卡人分红，该库存不可提前转出。
已完成释放的代币仍可由持有人转让，价格仍随市场变动。上述安排所排除的，是内部余额、可撤回的流动性，以及无对价形成的供给。

zh.l.en.rules.title: Card rules
zh.l.zh.rules.title: 卡牌规则
zh.l.en.rules.lead: Rules of the ANT.AI pool edition.
zh.l.zh.rules.lead: 依据 ANT.AI 开池版合约。
zh.l.en.rules.1.title: Supply
zh.l.zh.rules.1.title: 发行总量
zh.l.en.rules.1.body:
Cards: 777,777 total. 738,889 public mints and 38,888 team cards. Each address can mint at most 10. Transfers and burns do not restore the quota.
Tokens: 777,777,777 fixed in the contract. Nothing more can be minted. The whole supply is assigned. There is no reserve, and nobody can move an unassigned balance.
zh.l.zh.rules.1.body:
卡牌：共 777,777 张。738,889 张公开铸造，38,888 张团队卡。每个地址最多铸造 10 张，转让或销毁不恢复名额。
代币：总量固定 777,777,777 枚，合约写死，不能增发。全部分配完毕，没有预留额度，也没有任何人可以动用。
zh.l.en.rules.2.title: Token allocation
zh.l.zh.rules.2.title: 代币分配
zh.l.en.rules.2.body:
① Pool liquidity: 124,672,000 tokens (about 16.0%) enter with 36.75 BNB. The LP is burned.
② Presale grants: 20,000 × 8,440 = 168,800,000 tokens (about 21.7%). One fifth is released when the pool opens. The rest vests over five days from the open.
!Team cards are only 5% of all cards (38,888 / 777,777), and they are not released at once: one team card unlocks for every 19 paid mints. Team cards have the same rights as ordinary cards.
③ Ladder sales: 58,611,119 tokens (about 7.5%), sold only after the price rises. The BNB goes entirely to card holders. See Ladder sales below.
④ Burn at open: 97,479,938 tokens (about 12.5%) go to the dead address the moment the pool opens. They leave circulation for good. They do not enter the pool, a listing, or anyone's balance.
What remains after ①–④ is the team-card allocation. It is released card by card on the unlock pace above, not all at once.
Cards minted after the pool opens sit outside this allocation. They buy tokens in the pool with BNB: 10% is burned and 90% vests to the minting address over five days from that mint.
zh.l.zh.rules.2.body:
① 开池流动性：124,672,000 枚（约 16.0%），与 36.75 BNB 一起进池子，LP 直接销毁。
② 预售卡发放：20,000 张 × 8,440 = 168,800,000 枚（约 21.7%）。开池当时释放五分之一，其余自开池起五日释放。
!团队卡只占全部卡牌的 5%（38,888 / 777,777），而且不能一次放出：每铸出 19 张付费卡，才解锁 1 张团队卡。团队卡与普通卡同权。
③ 阶梯卖单：58,611,119 枚（约 7.5%），只在币价涨上去之后才卖，卖币得到的 BNB 全部分给持卡人。具体怎么运作见下面「阶梯卖单」一节。
④ 开池时销毁：97,479,938 枚（约 12.5%），开池那一刻直接打进黑洞地址，永久退出流通，不进入池子、不挂单、不计入任何人名下。
①–④ 之外剩下的部分对应团队卡，按上面的解锁节奏逐张放出，不会一次性进入流通。
开池后铸造的卡不占以上额度：它们用 BNB 当场在池子里买币，10% 销毁，90% 自该笔铸造起五日释放给铸造地址。
zh.l.en.rules.3.title: Presale
zh.l.zh.rules.3.title: 预售
zh.l.en.rules.3.body:
Listings and bids stay closed during the presale and open only after the pool opens.
The first 20,000 cards cost 0.00245 BNB, 49 BNB in total, over a 7-day window.
Each presale card grants 8,440 tokens. At the moment the pool opens, 1,688 are claimable. The remaining 6,752 vest linearly over five days. Tokens stay with the minting address.
If the presale does not sell out in 7 days, burning a presale card refunds its BNB.
zh.l.zh.rules.3.body:
预售期间不可以挂单。卖单和买单都要等开池以后。
前 20,000 张为预售，每张 0.00245 BNB，合计 49 BNB。预售窗口 7 天。
每张预售卡对应 8,440 枚。开池当时可领取 1,688 枚，其余 6,752 枚自开池起五日线性释放。代币记在铸造地址名下，不随卡牌转移。
7 天内没卖满，可销毁预售卡，全额退回 BNB。
zh.l.en.rules.4.title: Opening the pool
zh.l.zh.rules.4.title: 开池
zh.l.en.rules.4.body:
NFT duels open only after all 20,000 presale cards sell out and the pool opens.
The mint that sells the 20,000th card opens the pool in the same transaction: 36.75 BNB and 124,672,000 tokens enter, the LP is burned, and 97,479,938 tokens are transferred to the dead address in the same step.
If the seven-day window ends before sell-out, the pool does not open and a presale card may be burned for a full refund. After sell-out there is no refund.
zh.l.zh.rules.4.body:
NFT 对决要等预售卖满 20,000 张、开池以后才能参加。
售出第 20,000 张的同一笔交易开池：36.75 BNB 与 124,672,000 枚进入池子，流动性凭证销毁，同一步骤将 97,479,938 枚转入黑洞地址。
七日窗口结束时仍未售罄，开池不再进行，预售卡可销毁并全额退款。售罄之后不再退款。
zh.l.en.rules.5.title: Mints after the pool
zh.l.zh.rules.5.title: 开池后铸造
zh.l.en.rules.5.body:
After the pool opens, each card costs 0.0049 BNB with no further increase. 25% is operations. 75% buys tokens in the pool.
Of the tokens bought, 10% is burned and 90% vests to the minting address over five days from that mint. The amount depends on the pool price at execution.
zh.l.zh.rules.5.body:
开池后每张 0.0049 BNB，此后不再上调。25% 为运营费用，75% 当场在池中购入代币。
购得部分的 10% 立即销毁，90% 记在铸造地址名下，自该笔铸造起五日线性释放。到手数量按成交时池子价格决定。
zh.l.en.rules.6.title: Ladder sales
zh.l.zh.rules.6.title: 阶梯卖单
zh.l.en.rules.6.body:
In short: the vault holds tokens that sell in three fixed bands when the price reaches 1.5×, 2× and 3× the opening price. All of the BNB goes to card holders.
Opening price: 36.75 BNB ÷ 124,672,000 tokens, about 0.000000295 BNB each (about 3.39 million tokens per BNB).
Band one: about 19.537 million tokens at 1.5× the open. Band two: about 19.537 million at 2×. Band three: about 19.537 million at 3×.
A band opens only when the 30-minute average price reaches that band. If the price never gets there, none of those tokens sell. The average stops a one-trade spike from triggering a sale.
Anyone can buy an open band from the vault at its fixed price, and the tokens arrive immediately. A band closes when it sells out. The three bands total 58,611,119 tokens and are not refilled.
Once a band is open, the purchase may be below the market price at that moment.
Where the money goes: 100% of the BNB goes to card holders, not operations. It drips into dividends over 7 days, the same amount on every card.
!The higher the price climbs, the more BNB card holders receive from the ladder. If the price does not climb, the ladder does not move.
zh.l.zh.rules.6.body:
一句话：金库里留了一批币，等币价涨到开盘价的 1.5 倍、2 倍、3 倍时，分三档按固定价格卖出，卖得的 BNB 全部分给持卡人。
开盘价：36.75 BNB ÷ 124,672,000 枚，约每枚 0.000000295 BNB（即 1 BNB 约买 339 万枚）。
第一档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 1.5。第二档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 2。第三档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 3。
什么时候能买：只有当最近 30 分钟的平均币价达到或超过这一档价格时，这一档才开放。币价没涨到，这批币一枚都不会卖出，不会砸盘。用平均价是为了防止有人瞬间拉价格来触发。
谁来买：任何人都可以按这一档的固定价格直接从金库买，买到的币当场到账。每档卖完即关闭，三档总量就是 58,611,119 枚，卖完不再补充。
档位开放后，有可能以低于当时市价的价格买入。
钱去哪：卖币收到的 BNB 100% 给持卡人，不进运营。这笔 BNB 分 7 天匀速放进分红，每张卡分到一样多。
!简单说：币价涨得越高，持卡人从阶梯卖单拿到的 BNB 分红越多；币价不涨，阶梯卖单就不动。
zh.l.en.rules.7.title: Trade tax
zh.l.zh.rules.7.title: 交易税
zh.l.en.rules.7.body:
Each token trade pays 2%: 50% is an equal dividend per card, 30% fills the floor fund, and 20% is operations.
Dividends sit on the card until claimed. After a transfer, later dividends belong to the new holder.
zh.l.zh.rules.7.body:
代币每笔交易收 2% 税：50% 按卡等权分红，30% 进入地板基金，20% 为运营费用。
分红记在卡上，需主动领取。卡牌转让后，后续分红归新持有人。
zh.l.en.rules.8.title: Floor fund
zh.l.zh.rules.8.title: 地板基金
zh.l.en.rules.8.body:
What it does: it holds the floor. It buys the cheapest listings one by one and burns the cards, so cheap asks are cleared and the floor cannot be walked down.
Where the money comes from: 30% of the 2% trade tax. It sits in the vault, can only buy cards, and nobody can withdraw it.
A fee reserve comes first: the fund tops up 0.02 BNB. That reserve pays the automation fee and is never used to buy cards.
When it buys: once every 30 minutes, and anyone can trigger a run.
How it buys: upward from the lowest ask. While the price is under the cap and the fund can pay, it buys the listing in full. At the same price, presale and team cards come before post-pool cards.
What the seller receives: the list price plus the dividend accrued on that card, settled immediately.
The card is burned: it is gone, supply shrinks, and the cards that remain are scarcer.
Caps: 0.00245 BNB for presale and team cards, 0.0049 BNB for post-pool cards. Asks above the cap are skipped.
Extra burn: when a post-pool card is bought, only tokens that are still locked burn. Tokens already unlocked stay with the holder even if they have not been claimed. Tokens already claimed stay with the previous holder. Presale and team-card tokens are not touched.
When it stops: the next ask is above the fund balance, or above 0.0049 BNB. That round ends and waits for the next one.
!More trading fills the fund, cheap asks clear faster, more cards burn, and the floor rises. The money comes from the market itself.
zh.l.zh.rules.8.body:
它是干什么的：托底。市场上最便宜的卖单被它一张一张买走并销毁，低价单被清空、卡被烧掉，地板价就被抬住，想砸盘也砸不穿。
钱从哪来：每笔交易 2% 税里的 30% 进地板基金，记在金库合约里，只用来买卡，任何人都取不走。
先留一笔执行费：基金先补足 0.02 BNB 的触发储备，这笔钱只付自动化服务的手续费，绝不用于买卡。
什么时候买：每 30 分钟自动跑一次，任何人也可以手动触发一次。
怎么买：从市场最低挂单往上排，一路买过去。只要挂价在封顶线以内、基金余额够，就按卖家挂的价格全额买下；同一价位上，预售卡和团队卡优先，然后才是开池后铸造的卡。
卖家拿到多少：挂单价 + 这张卡到目前为止累积的分红，一分不少，当场结清。
买到的卡直接销毁：卡永久消失，总供应量变少，剩下的卡更稀缺。
封顶线：预售卡和团队卡最高 0.00245 BNB，开池后铸造的卡最高 0.0049 BNB。挂价高于封顶线的单不接。
顺带销毁：开池后铸造的卡被买走时，只销毁还锁着的代币。已经解锁、只是还没领的，留在持有人手里。已经领走的也不动。预售卡和团队卡的代币不动。
什么时候停：下一档价格超过基金余额，或者超过 0.0049 BNB，这一轮就停，等下一轮。
!简单说：交易越多，基金越有钱，低价单清得越快，卡烧得越多，地板就越高。托底的钱来自市场本身，不靠任何人掏腰包。
zh.l.en.rules.9.title: Team cards
zh.l.zh.rules.9.title: 团队卡
zh.l.en.rules.9.body: One team card activates for every 19 paid mints, 38,888 in total, inside the supply. Team cards have the same rights as ordinary cards.
zh.l.zh.rules.9.body: 每铸造 19 张付费卡，激活 1 张团队卡，共 38,888 张，包含在总量内。团队卡与普通卡同权，没有额外权益。
zh.l.en.rules.10.title: How to mint
zh.l.zh.rules.10.title: 铸造方式
zh.l.en.rules.10.body:
Mints are sent from the Binance Agent Wallet after you confirm them. This site does not sign or broadcast for you.
Prices move. The project does not promise a fixed return.
zh.l.en.rules.11.title: Constraints on sell pressure
zh.l.en.rules.11.body:
Sell pressure of this kind usually comes from three unconstrained sources: an insider balance that can be transferred at will, liquidity that can be withdrawn, and a discounted allocation that enters circulation at the open. The model addresses each of them.
!The team does not hold a separate token balance. Its interest takes the form of cards: one card unlocks for every 19 paid mints, with the same rights as ordinary cards. Team cards are 5% of all cards.
The liquidity position is burned when the pool opens and cannot be withdrawn.
In the same transaction, 97,479,938 tokens are transferred to the dead address. They do not enter any balance.
Of the tokens corresponding to the presale, one fifth is released when the pool opens. The rest vests over five days from the open.
Mints after the open do not create supply without consideration. Seventy-five percent of the amount paid buys tokens from the pool. Of the tokens bought, 10% is burned immediately and 90% vests over five days from that mint.
The only prearranged sale is the ladder. A fixed quantity is sold only when the 30-minute average reaches 1.5×, 2×, or 3× the opening price. Below those levels, nothing is sold. Proceeds are credited entirely to card holders, and that inventory cannot be transferred in advance.
Tokens that have completed vesting remain transferable, and the price remains subject to the market. The arrangements above exclude an insider balance, withdrawable liquidity, and supply created without consideration.
zh.l.zh.rules.10.body:
铸造通过币安 Agent 钱包发起，由你在钱包里确认后执行。网站不代你签名，也不代发交易。
数字资产价格会波动，项目不承诺任何固定收益。
zh.l.zh.rules.11.title: 抛压约束
zh.l.zh.rules.11.body:
此类抛压通常来自三处未加约束的供给：可自由转让的内部余额、可撤回的流动性，以及开盘即进入流通的折价份额。本模型对三者分别作了安排。
!团队不持有独立的代币余额。团队权益以卡牌形式存在，每完成 19 张付费铸造解锁 1 张，与普通卡同权。团队卡占全部卡牌的 5%。
开池时流动性凭证予以销毁，流动性不可撤回。
同一笔交易将 97,479,938 枚转入黑洞地址，该部分不进入任何地址余额。
预售对应代币于开池当时释放五分之一，其余部分自开池起五日释放。
开池之后的铸造不形成无对价供给。所付金额的 75% 用于在池中购入代币；购得部分的 10% 立即销毁，90% 自该笔铸造起按五日线性释放。
唯一预先安排的出售为阶梯卖单。仅当三十分钟均价达到开盘价的 1.5 倍、2 倍或 3 倍时，按既定数量成交；未达相应价格则不出售。所得计价资产全部计入持卡人分红，该库存不可提前转出。
已完成释放的代币仍可由持有人转让，价格仍随市场变动。上述安排所排除的，是内部余额、可撤回的流动性，以及无对价形成的供给。

Call list(uint256[] tokenIds, uint256[] prices) on the cards contract {cards}. The card stays in the wallet. Calling again changes the price. Each price must be a positive multiple of 10000000000000 wei. value wei is 0. Wait until I give tokenIds and prices, then encode that function. Do not look up an ABI. If inputData is STOP_NEED_ARGS, stop and do not preview. If the address is MISSING, stop.
Check Developer Mode, then read my wallet address and replace 0xYourAgentWallet with it. Preview only and show me the result. Do not execute until I reply yes.
baw wallet settings --json
baw wallet address --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {data} --json

zh.l.en.cmd.sync.title: Sync tax
zh.l.en.cmd.sync.desc: Indexes unrecognized tax as 50% dividend, 30% floor, and 20% operations. No batch condition.
zh.l.en.cmd.sync.text:
You are my Binance Agent Wallet assistant. Network: BNB Chain, chainId=56. Cards: [cards]. Vault: [vault]. If an address is still a bracket placeholder, stop and do not call another contract. The contract source is not verified. Use the function signatures written below. Do not look up the ABI. Read first. Show the function, arguments, BNB value and gas, and send only after I confirm. Stop on failure. Never ask for or export a private key.
Call function sync() on Vault. Read unrecognizedTax() first and tell me the amount. sync indexes it as 50% dividend, 30% floor, and 20% operations. value is 0. There is no batch and no seven-day wait.
zh.l.en.cmd.sync.short:
You are my Binance Agent Wallet assistant. Network: BNB Chain (chainId=56). Cards: [cards]. Vault: [vault]. If an address is still a bracket placeholder, stop. Do not call another contract. Call the functions below directly. Do not look up the ABI.
function unrecognizedTax() view returns (uint256). Contract: Vault. value: 0. Read only. Tell me this amount.
function sync(). Contract: Vault. value: 0. It indexes that tax as 50% dividend, 30% floor, and 20% operations. There is no batch. Show the preview and send only after I confirm.

zh.l.zh.cmd.wallet.title: 查询我的钱包
zh.l.zh.cmd.wallet.desc: 只读：Agent ID、持卡张数、剩余铸造名额（上限 10）。
zh.l.zh.cmd.wallet.text:
你是我的币安钱包助手。网络是 BNB Chain，chainId 56。
这是只读查询，不要执行交易。Agent ID 合约是 {agent}。用我的钱包地址调用 balanceOf(address)，看我有没有 Agent ID。这一笔 inputData 要用查到的地址自己编码，不要查 ABI。然后读卡片合约 {cards}：launched() 看池子开了没有，paidMinted() 看已经铸了多少张，presaleDeadline() 看预售什么时候截止。这三笔 inputData 已经编好，不要重编。地址如果是 MISSING 就停住。
先确认开发者模式，再查出我的钱包地址，用它替换 0xYourAgentWallet。只做预览，把结果给我看。不要执行。
baw wallet settings --json
baw wallet address --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {agent} --value 0 --inputData <用查到的钱包地址编码 balanceOf(address)> --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataLaunched} --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataPaid} --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataDeadline} --json
不要运行 contract-call execute。

zh.l.zh.ladder.lead: 金库按开盘价的固定倍数，出售预先留存的代币。

zh.l.zh.ladder.unlaunched: 池子尚未打开，暂不可购买。
zh.ladder.explain:
金库留有 58,611,119 枚，分成三档出售。价格在开池时写定，分别为开盘价的 1.5 倍、2 倍和 3 倍，此后不再变动。
某一档能否购买，只看最近三十分钟的平均价格。平均价格达到该档，该档才开放；未达到，则该档一枚也不出售。
购买以 BNB 按该档的固定价格支付。档位开放后，有可能以低于当时市价的价格买入。代币立即记入付款地址。收到的 BNB 全部计入持卡人分红，分七日释放，不计入运营费用。
一次购买只对应一档。同一地址可以买下该档的全部剩余，但不得超过该档尚余的数量。该档售罄后关闭，不再补充。
购买不要求持有卡牌。Agent ID 仅在铸造卡牌时需要。已连接的钱包使用本页按钮。使用 Agent 钱包时，复制下面的指令。
zh.l.en.ladder.explain:
The vault holds 58,611,119 tokens in three bands. Each price is fixed at the open — 1.5×, 2× and 3× the opening price — and does not change afterward.
A band can be bought only when the average price of the last 30 minutes has reached that band. Below it, none of the band is sold.
Payment is made in BNB at the band's fixed price. Once a band is open, the purchase may be below the market price at that moment. The tokens are credited to the paying address at once. All of the BNB is credited to card holders and released over seven days. None of it is taken as an operations fee.
One purchase covers a single band. An address may buy the entire remainder of that band. The amount cannot exceed what the band still holds. The band closes when it is sold out and is not refilled.
The purchase does not require a card. An Agent ID is required only when minting a card. A connected wallet uses the button on this page. An Agent wallet uses the command below.

zh.l.en.duel.title: NFT duel
zh.l.zh.duel.title: NFT 对决
zh.duel.lead: 持卡人可将一张卡放入房间对决。
zh.l.en.duel.lead: NFT duels open only after all 20,000 presale cards sell out and the pool opens. A holder may then place one card in a room.
zh.l.zh.duel.lead: NFT 对决要等预售卖满 20,000 张、开池以后才能参加。持卡人可将一张卡放入房间对决。
zh.duel.1.title: 房间
zh.l.en.duel.1.title: Rooms
zh.l.zh.duel.1.title: 房间
zh.duel.1.body: 共 100 间，编号 1 至 100。空房间用于等待，已有人的房间用于应战。同一地址不能同时占用两间，也不能与自己对决。对决开始后，该房间立即空出。
zh.l.en.duel.1.body: There are 100 rooms, numbered 1 to 100. An empty room waits. A room that already has a card starts the match. One address cannot occupy two rooms, or play both sides of the same room. Once a match starts, the room is free again.
zh.l.zh.duel.1.body: 共 100 间，编号 1 至 100。空房间用于等待，已有人的房间用于应战。同一地址不能同时占用两间，也不能与自己对决。对决开始后，该房间立即空出。
zh.duel.2.title: 开奖
zh.l.en.duel.2.title: Result
zh.l.zh.duel.2.title: 开奖
zh.duel.2.body:
双方入座后约 60 秒开奖。开奖采用公平随机，取已封存的前一区块哈希，双方胜率相等，参与者无法干预。开奖前不公布胜负。胜者获得两张卡。胜次记在出战的卡上，卡牌转让后仍然保留。
开打满 1 小时仍没有赢家，两张卡退回原持有人，该场不计入胜次。
zh.l.en.duel.2.body:
The result is drawn about 60 seconds after both cards are seated. The draw is fair. It uses the already sealed hash of the previous block. Each side has an equal chance, and a participant cannot influence it. It is not shown before then. The winner receives both cards. Wins are recorded on the card that fought, and they remain if the card is transferred.
If one hour passes after the match starts and there is still no winner, both cards return to their holders and the match does not count.

zh.duel.3.title: 第六胜
zh.l.en.duel.3.title: The sixth win
zh.l.zh.duel.3.title: 第六胜
zh.duel.3.body:
同一张卡累计获胜五次后，下一次获胜时，刚赢得的卡予以销毁，己方卡牌退回，该卡胜次归零。
若被销毁的是开池后铸造的卡，只销毁还锁着的代币。已经解锁、只是还没领的，留在持有人手里。已经领取的不受影响。
zh.l.en.duel.3.body:
After a card has won five times, the next win burns the card just taken. The winner's own card is returned, and that card's win count returns to zero.
If the burned card was minted after the pool opened, only the tokens that are still locked are burned. Tokens already unlocked stay with the holder even if they have not been claimed. Tokens already claimed are unaffected.
zh.l.zh.duel.3.body:
同一张卡累计获胜五次后，下一次获胜时，刚赢得的卡予以销毁，己方卡牌退回，该卡胜次归零。
若被销毁的是开池后铸造的卡，只销毁还锁着的代币。已经解锁、只是还没领的，留在持有人手里。已经领取的不受影响。
zh.duel.4.title: 费用与退出
zh.l.en.duel.4.title: Fee and withdrawal
zh.l.zh.duel.4.title: 费用与退出
zh.duel.4.body:
开奖费为 0.0002 BNB，付给 Flap，作为基础设施费用。入座缴纳一半，即 0.0001 BNB，金额必须一致。对决开始时，若金库 0.1 BNB 的余额足以支付开奖费，双方押金退回；否则押金用于支付开奖费。
取消等待时，卡牌、押金及等待期间累计的分红一并退回。对决开始后不可取消。
zh.l.en.duel.4.body:
The drawing fee is 0.0002 BNB, paid to Flap as an infrastructure fee. Entry requires exactly half, 0.0001 BNB. When a match starts, both deposits are returned if the vault's 0.1 BNB balance covers the drawing fee. Otherwise the deposits pay the fee.
Cancelling a wait returns the card, the deposit, and any dividend accrued while waiting. A match that has started cannot be cancelled.

zh.cmd.refund.text:
You are the Binance wallet panel. Network: BNB Chain, chainId 56. Use the wallet already selected in this panel. Do not ask me for a wallet name or for tokenIds.
Refund the MINT.AI presale now. The cards contract is {cards}. It is the ERC721 named MINT.AI. The pool never opened, so these cards cannot have been transferred.
Do all of this in this one message. First read every tokenId this wallet holds on that contract. Use this wallet's NFT holdings in the panel. If the holdings list does not show them, read PaidMint events on that contract where minter is this wallet and take the tokenId from each event.
As soon as you have the tokenIds, encode refund(uint256[] tokenIds) with value 0. At most 250 cards in this call. Show only the confirmation card. Broadcast only after I tap execute. If this wallet holds none, say so. Do not ask me to supply tokenIds.
This panel has no baw commands. Do not run baw, do not write an inputData placeholder, and do not stop to wait for parameters.

zh.duel.depositNote:
开奖费为 0.0002 BNB，付给 Flap，作为基础设施费用。已付押金为其一半，即 0.0001 BNB，金额必须一致，否则无法入座。
对决开始时，若金库 0.1 BNB 的余额足以支付开奖费，双方押金退回；否则押金用于支付开奖费。
开奖采用公平随机，取已封存的前一区块哈希，双方胜率相等，参与者无法干预。
等待可以取消，卡牌与押金一并退回。对决开始后不可取消。
zh.l.en.duel.depositNote:
The drawing fee is 0.0002 BNB, paid to Flap as an infrastructure fee. The deposit is half of it, 0.0001 BNB, and must match exactly or entry does not proceed.
When a match starts, both deposits are returned if the vault's 0.1 BNB balance covers the drawing fee. Otherwise the deposits pay the fee.
The draw is fair. It uses the already sealed hash of the previous block. Each side has an equal chance, and a participant cannot influence it.
A waiting player may cancel and recover the card and the deposit. A match that has started cannot be cancelled.

ko.rules.title: 카드 규칙
ko.rules.1.title: 발행량
ko.rules.1.body:
카드는 총 777,777장입니다. 공개 민팅 738,889장, 팀 카드 38,888장. 주소당 최대 10장이며 전송이나 소각으로 한도가 회복되지 않습니다.
토큰은 777,777,777개로 계약에 고정되어 추가 발행할 수 없습니다. 전량이 배분되어 있으며 예비분도, 아무나 옮길 수 있는 잔량도 없습니다.
ko.rules.2.title: 토큰 배분
ko.rules.2.body:
① 풀 유동성: 124,672,000개(약 16.0%)가 36.75 BNB와 함께 들어가고 LP는 소각됩니다.
② 프리세일 지급: 20,000 × 8,440 = 168,800,000개(약 21.7%). 개장 순간 5분의 1이 해제되고, 나머지는 개장 시점부터 5일 해제됩니다.
!팀 카드는 전체 카드의 5%(38,888 / 777,777)이며 한 번에 풀리지 않습니다. 유료 민팅 19장마다 팀 카드 1장이 해제되고, 일반 카드와 같은 권리입니다.
③ 계단 매도: 58,611,119개(약 7.5%). 가격이 오른 뒤에만 팔리고 BNB는 전부 카드 보유자에게 갑니다. 자세한 내용은 아래 계단 매도를 보세요.
④ 오픈 시 소각: 97,479,938개(약 12.5%)가 풀이 열리는 순간 블랙홀 주소로 갑니다. 유통에서 영구히 빠지며 풀, 매도, 누구의 잔고에도 들어가지 않습니다.
①–④ 밖의 나머지는 팀 카드 물량입니다. 위 해제 속도대로 한 장씩 나오며 한 번에 유통되지 않습니다.
풀 오픈 후 민팅한 카드는 이 배분에 포함되지 않습니다. BNB로 풀에서 즉시 매수하고, 10%는 소각, 90%는 그 민팅 시점부터 5일 해제되어 민팅 주소에 귀속됩니다.
ko.rules.3.title: 프리세일
ko.rules.3.body:
처음 20,000장은 장당 0.00245 BNB, 합계 49 BNB, 기간 7일입니다.
카드마다 8,440개입니다. 풀이 열리는 순간 1,688개를 청구할 수 있고, 나머지 6,752개는 개장 시점부터 5일에 걸쳐 선형 해제됩니다. 토큰은 민팅 주소에 남습니다.
7일 안에 매진되지 않으면 프리세일 카드를 소각해 BNB를 전액 환불할 수 있습니다.
ko.rules.4.title: 풀 오픈
ko.rules.4.body:
20,000번째 카드가 판매되는 거래에서 풀이 열립니다. 36.75 BNB와 124,672,000개가 들어가고 LP가 소각되며, 같은 단계에서 97,479,938개가 소각 주소로 이전됩니다.
7일 창이 매진 전에 끝나면 풀은 열리지 않고, 프리세일 카드는 소각 후 전액 환불됩니다. 매진 이후에는 환불되지 않습니다.
ko.rules.5.title: 풀 오픈 후 민팅
ko.rules.5.body:
풀이 열린 뒤 민팅은 장당 0.0049 BNB이며 가격은 더 오르지 않습니다. 25%는 운영 비용이고, 75%는 풀에서 즉시 매수합니다.
매수분의 10%는 즉시 소각되고, 90%는 민팅 주소에 그 민팅 시점부터 5일 선형 해제됩니다. 수량은 체결 시점의 풀 가격에 따릅니다.
ko.rules.6.title: 계단 매도
ko.rules.6.body:
한 줄로: 금고의 물량은 시세가 시초가의 1.5배, 2배, 3배에 닿을 때 세 구간으로 고정가 매도되고, BNB는 전부 카드 보유자에게 갑니다.
시초가: 36.75 BNB ÷ 124,672,000개, 개당 약 0.000000295 BNB(BNB 1개로 약 339만 개).
1구간 약 1,953.7만 개, 가격 = 시초가 × 1.5. 2구간 약 1,953.7만 개, × 2. 3구간 약 1,953.7만 개, × 3.
최근 30분 평균 가격이 그 구간에 닿아야 열립니다. 닿지 않으면 한 개도 팔리지 않습니다. 평균가는 순간 급등으로 매도를 켜는 것을 막습니다.
누구나 열린 구간을 고정가로 금고에서 살 수 있고 토큰은 즉시 도착합니다. 구간이 매진되면 닫히며, 세 구간 합계 58,611,119개는 보충되지 않습니다.
구간이 열리면 당시 시장가보다 낮은 가격에 매수할 수 있습니다.
대금의 100%는 카드 보유자에게 가고 운영으로 가지 않습니다. BNB는 7일에 걸쳐 카드마다 같게 배당됩니다.
!가격이 더 오를수록 계단 매도에서 카드 보유자가 받는 BNB가 늘어납니다. 가격이 오르지 않으면 계단 매도는 움직이지 않습니다.
ko.rules.7.title: 거래세
ko.rules.7.body:
토큰 거래마다 2%입니다. 50%는 카드당 균등 배당, 30%는 바닥 기금, 20%는 운영입니다.
배당은 청구할 때까지 카드에 남습니다. 이전 이후의 배당은 새 보유자에게 귀속됩니다.
ko.rules.8.title: 바닥 기금
ko.rules.8.body:
역할: 바닥을 받칩니다. 가장 싼 매도부터 한 장씩 사서 카드를 소각하므로 저가 물량이 비고 바닥이 내려가지 않습니다.
재원: 거래세 2%의 30%. 금고에 잠겨 카드 매수에만 쓰이며 아무도 인출할 수 없습니다.
실행 수수료를 먼저 남깁니다. 0.02 BNB 트리거 준비금은 자동화 수수료만 내고 카드 매수에 쓰지 않습니다.
30분마다 자동 실행되고, 누구나 한 번 트리거할 수 있습니다.
가장 낮은 호가부터 위로 삽니다. 상한 안이고 잔액이 충분하면 호가 전액을 삽니다. 같은 가격에서는 프리세일과 팀 카드가 먼저입니다.
판매자는 호가와 그 카드에 쌓인 배당을 즉시 받습니다.
산 카드는 영구 소각되어 공급이 줄고 남은 카드는 더 희소해집니다.
상한: 프리세일·팀 카드 0.00245 BNB, 이후 카드 0.0049 BNB. 상한을 넘는 호가는 받지 않습니다.
추가 소각: 이후 카드가 팔리면 아직 잠겨 있는 토큰만 소각됩니다. 이미 잠금이 풀렸지만 아직 받지 않은 토큰은 보유자에게 남습니다. 이미 받은 토큰은 원래 보유자에게 남습니다. 프리세일과 팀 카드의 토큰은 건드리지 않습니다.
다음 호가가 기금 잔액보다 크거나 0.0049 BNB를 넘으면 그 라운드는 멈추고 다음을 기다립니다.
!거래가 늘수록 기금이 불어 저가 물량이 더 빨리 비고, 카드가 더 많이 타며, 바닥이 높아집니다. 받치는 돈은 시장 자체에서 나옵니다.
ko.rules.9.title: 팀 카드
ko.rules.9.body: 유료 민팅 19장마다 팀 카드 1장이 활성화되며 총 38,888장입니다. 공급량에 포함되고 일반 카드와 같은 권리입니다.
ko.rules.10.title: 민팅 방법
ko.rules.10.body:
민팅은 바이낸스 Agent 지갑에서 본인이 확인한 뒤 전송됩니다. 이 사이트는 대신 서명하거나 전송하지 않습니다.
가격은 변동하며 프로젝트는 고정 수익을 약속하지 않습니다.
ko.rules.11.title: 매도 압력의 제약
ko.rules.11.body:
이러한 매도 압력은 보통 세 가지 제약 없는 공급에서 옵니다. 임의로 이전할 수 있는 내부 잔액, 회수할 수 있는 유동성, 그리고 개장과 동시에 유통에 들어가는 할인 물량입니다. 본 모델은 각각을 따로 정합니다.
!팀은 별도의 토큰 잔액을 보유하지 않습니다. 팀의 권리는 카드로 존재하며, 유료 민팅 19장마다 1장이 해제되고, 일반 카드와 같은 권리입니다. 팀 카드는 전체 카드의 5%입니다.
개장 시 유동성 증서는 소각되며, 유동성은 회수할 수 없습니다.
같은 거래에서 97,479,938개가 소각 주소로 이전됩니다. 이 수량은 어떤 주소의 잔액에도 들어가지 않습니다.
프리세일에 대응하는 토큰은 개장 순간 5분의 1이 해제되고, 나머지는 개장 시점부터 5일 해제됩니다.
개장 이후의 민팅은 대가 없는 공급을 만들지 않습니다. 지급액의 75%는 풀에서 토큰을 매수하는 데 사용됩니다. 매수분 가운데 10%는 즉시 소각되고, 90%는 그 민팅 시점부터 5일에 걸쳐 선형 해제됩니다.
미리 정한 매도는 사다리 매도뿐입니다. 30분 평균가가 시가의 1.5배, 2배 또는 3배에 도달할 때에만 정해진 수량이 체결됩니다. 해당 가격에 미달하면 매도하지 않습니다. 대금은 전부 카드 보유자의 배당으로 계상되며, 그 재고는 미리 이전할 수 없습니다.
해제가 끝난 토큰은 보유자가 이전할 수 있고, 가격은 시장에 따릅니다. 위의 정리가 배제하는 것은 내부 잔액, 회수 가능한 유동성, 그리고 대가 없이 형성된 공급입니다.

ko.l.zh.rules.title: 卡牌规则
ko.l.en.rules.lead: Rules of the ANT.AI pool edition.
ko.l.zh.rules.lead: 依据 ANT.AI 开池版合约。
ko.l.en.rules.1.title: Supply
ko.l.zh.rules.1.title: 发行总量
ko.l.en.rules.1.body:
Cards: 777,777 total. 738,889 public mints and 38,888 team cards. Each address can mint at most 10. Transfers and burns do not restore the quota.
Tokens: 777,777,777 fixed in the contract. Nothing more can be minted. The whole supply is assigned. There is no reserve, and nobody can move an unassigned balance.
ko.l.zh.rules.1.body:
卡牌：共 777,777 张。738,889 张公开铸造，38,888 张团队卡。每个地址最多铸造 10 张，转让或销毁不恢复名额。
代币：总量固定 777,777,777 枚，合约写死，不能增发。全部分配完毕，没有预留额度，也没有任何人可以动用。
ko.l.en.rules.2.title: Token allocation
ko.l.zh.rules.2.title: 代币分配
ko.l.en.rules.2.body:
① Pool liquidity: 124,672,000 tokens (about 16.0%) enter with 36.75 BNB. The LP is burned.
② Presale grants: 20,000 × 8,440 = 168,800,000 tokens (about 21.7%). One fifth is released when the pool opens. The rest vests over five days from the open.
!Team cards are only 5% of all cards (38,888 / 777,777), and they are not released at once: one team card unlocks for every 19 paid mints. Team cards have the same rights as ordinary cards.
③ Ladder sales: 58,611,119 tokens (about 7.5%), sold only after the price rises. The BNB goes entirely to card holders. See Ladder sales below.
④ Burn at open: 97,479,938 tokens (about 12.5%) go to the dead address the moment the pool opens. They leave circulation for good. They do not enter the pool, a listing, or anyone's balance.
What remains after ①–④ is the team-card allocation. It is released card by card on the unlock pace above, not all at once.
Cards minted after the pool opens sit outside this allocation. They buy tokens in the pool with BNB: 10% is burned and 90% vests to the minting address over five days from that mint.
ko.l.zh.rules.2.body:
① 开池流动性：124,672,000 枚（约 16.0%），与 36.75 BNB 一起进池子，LP 直接销毁。
② 预售卡发放：20,000 张 × 8,440 = 168,800,000 枚（约 21.7%）。开池当时释放五分之一，其余自开池起五日释放。
!团队卡只占全部卡牌的 5%（38,888 / 777,777），而且不能一次放出：每铸出 19 张付费卡，才解锁 1 张团队卡。团队卡与普通卡同权。
③ 阶梯卖单：58,611,119 枚（约 7.5%），只在币价涨上去之后才卖，卖币得到的 BNB 全部分给持卡人。具体怎么运作见下面「阶梯卖单」一节。
④ 开池时销毁：97,479,938 枚（约 12.5%），开池那一刻直接打进黑洞地址，永久退出流通，不进入池子、不挂单、不计入任何人名下。
①–④ 之外剩下的部分对应团队卡，按上面的解锁节奏逐张放出，不会一次性进入流通。
开池后铸造的卡不占以上额度：它们用 BNB 当场在池子里买币，10% 销毁，90% 自该笔铸造起五日释放给铸造地址。
ko.l.en.rules.3.title: Presale
ko.l.zh.rules.3.title: 预售
ko.l.en.rules.3.body:
Listings and bids stay closed during the presale and open only after the pool opens.
The first 20,000 cards cost 0.00245 BNB, 49 BNB in total, over a 7-day window.
Each presale card grants 8,440 tokens. At the moment the pool opens, 1,688 are claimable. The remaining 6,752 vest linearly over five days. Tokens stay with the minting address.
If the presale does not sell out in 7 days, burning a presale card refunds its BNB.
ko.l.zh.rules.3.body:
预售期间不可以挂单。卖单和买单都要等开池以后。
前 20,000 张为预售，每张 0.00245 BNB，合计 49 BNB。预售窗口 7 天。
每张预售卡对应 8,440 枚。开池当时可领取 1,688 枚，其余 6,752 枚自开池起五日线性释放。代币记在铸造地址名下，不随卡牌转移。
7 天内没卖满，可销毁预售卡，全额退回 BNB。
ko.l.en.rules.4.title: Opening the pool
ko.l.zh.rules.4.title: 开池
ko.l.en.rules.4.body:
NFT duels open only after all 20,000 presale cards sell out and the pool opens.
The mint that sells the 20,000th card opens the pool in the same transaction: 36.75 BNB and 124,672,000 tokens enter, the LP is burned, and 97,479,938 tokens are transferred to the dead address in the same step.
If the seven-day window ends before sell-out, the pool does not open and a presale card may be burned for a full refund. After sell-out there is no refund.
ko.l.zh.rules.4.body:
NFT 对决要等预售卖满 20,000 张、开池以后才能参加。
售出第 20,000 张的同一笔交易开池：36.75 BNB 与 124,672,000 枚进入池子，流动性凭证销毁，同一步骤将 97,479,938 枚转入黑洞地址。
七日窗口结束时仍未售罄，开池不再进行，预售卡可销毁并全额退款。售罄之后不再退款。
ko.l.en.rules.5.title: Mints after the pool
ko.l.zh.rules.5.title: 开池后铸造
ko.l.en.rules.5.body:
After the pool opens, each card costs 0.0049 BNB with no further increase. 25% is operations. 75% buys tokens in the pool.
Of the tokens bought, 10% is burned and 90% vests to the minting address over five days from that mint. The amount depends on the pool price at execution.
ko.l.zh.rules.5.body:
开池后每张 0.0049 BNB，此后不再上调。25% 为运营费用，75% 当场在池中购入代币。
购得部分的 10% 立即销毁，90% 记在铸造地址名下，自该笔铸造起五日线性释放。到手数量按成交时池子价格决定。
ko.l.en.rules.6.title: Ladder sales
ko.l.zh.rules.6.title: 阶梯卖单
ko.l.en.rules.6.body:
In short: the vault holds tokens that sell in three fixed bands when the price reaches 1.5×, 2× and 3× the opening price. All of the BNB goes to card holders.
Opening price: 36.75 BNB ÷ 124,672,000 tokens, about 0.000000295 BNB each (about 3.39 million tokens per BNB).
Band one: about 19.537 million tokens at 1.5× the open. Band two: about 19.537 million at 2×. Band three: about 19.537 million at 3×.
A band opens only when the 30-minute average price reaches that band. If the price never gets there, none of those tokens sell. The average stops a one-trade spike from triggering a sale.
Anyone can buy an open band from the vault at its fixed price, and the tokens arrive immediately. A band closes when it sells out. The three bands total 58,611,119 tokens and are not refilled.
Once a band is open, the purchase may be below the market price at that moment.
Where the money goes: 100% of the BNB goes to card holders, not operations. It drips into dividends over 7 days, the same amount on every card.
!The higher the price climbs, the more BNB card holders receive from the ladder. If the price does not climb, the ladder does not move.
ko.l.zh.rules.6.body:
一句话：金库里留了一批币，等币价涨到开盘价的 1.5 倍、2 倍、3 倍时，分三档按固定价格卖出，卖得的 BNB 全部分给持卡人。
开盘价：36.75 BNB ÷ 124,672,000 枚，约每枚 0.000000295 BNB（即 1 BNB 约买 339 万枚）。
第一档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 1.5。第二档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 2。第三档：约 1,953.7 万枚，价格 = 开盘价 × 3。
什么时候能买：只有当最近 30 分钟的平均币价达到或超过这一档价格时，这一档才开放。币价没涨到，这批币一枚都不会卖出，不会砸盘。用平均价是为了防止有人瞬间拉价格来触发。
谁来买：任何人都可以按这一档的固定价格直接从金库买，买到的币当场到账。每档卖完即关闭，三档总量就是 58,611,119 枚，卖完不再补充。
档位开放后，有可能以低于当时市价的价格买入。
钱去哪：卖币收到的 BNB 100% 给持卡人，不进运营。这笔 BNB 分 7 天匀速放进分红，每张卡分到一样多。
!简单说：币价涨得越高，持卡人从阶梯卖单拿到的 BNB 分红越多；币价不涨，阶梯卖单就不动。
ko.l.en.rules.7.title: Trade tax
ko.l.zh.rules.7.title: 交易税
ko.l.en.rules.7.body:
Each token trade pays 2%: 50% is an equal dividend per card, 30% fills the floor fund, and 20% is operations.
Dividends sit on the card until claimed. After a transfer, later dividends belong to the new holder.
ko.l.zh.rules.7.body:
代币每笔交易收 2% 税：50% 按卡等权分红，30% 进入地板基金，20% 为运营费用。
分红记在卡上，需主动领取。卡牌转让后，后续分红归新持有人。
ko.l.en.rules.8.title: Floor fund
ko.l.zh.rules.8.title: 地板基金
ko.l.en.rules.8.body:
What it does: it holds the floor. It buys the cheapest listings one by one and burns the cards, so cheap asks are cleared and the floor cannot be walked down.
Where the money comes from: 30% of the 2% trade tax. It sits in the vault, can only buy cards, and nobody can withdraw it.
A fee reserve comes first: the fund tops up 0.02 BNB. That reserve pays the automation fee and is never used to buy cards.
When it buys: once every 30 minutes, and anyone can trigger a run.
How it buys: upward from the lowest ask. While the price is under the cap and the fund can pay, it buys the listing in full. At the same price, presale and team cards come before post-pool cards.
What the seller receives: the list price plus the dividend accrued on that card, settled immediately.
The card is burned: it is gone, supply shrinks, and the cards that remain are scarcer.
Caps: 0.00245 BNB for presale and team cards, 0.0049 BNB for post-pool cards. Asks above the cap are skipped.
Extra burn: when a post-pool card is bought, only tokens that are still locked burn. Tokens already unlocked stay with the holder even if they have not been claimed. Tokens already claimed stay with the previous holder. Presale and team-card tokens are not touched.
When it stops: the next ask is above the fund balance, or above 0.0049 BNB. That round ends and waits for the next one.
!More trading fills the fund, cheap asks clear faster, more cards burn, and the floor rises. The money comes from the market itself.
ko.l.zh.rules.8.body:
它是干什么的：托底。市场上最便宜的卖单被它一张一张买走并销毁，低价单被清空、卡被烧掉，地板价就被抬住，想砸盘也砸不穿。
钱从哪来：每笔交易 2% 税里的 30% 进地板基金，记在金库合约里，只用来买卡，任何人都取不走。
先留一笔执行费：基金先补足 0.02 BNB 的触发储备，这笔钱只付自动化服务的手续费，绝不用于买卡。
什么时候买：每 30 分钟自动跑一次，任何人也可以手动触发一次。
怎么买：从市场最低挂单往上排，一路买过去。只要挂价在封顶线以内、基金余额够，就按卖家挂的价格全额买下；同一价位上，预售卡和团队卡优先，然后才是开池后铸造的卡。
卖家拿到多少：挂单价 + 这张卡到目前为止累积的分红，一分不少，当场结清。
买到的卡直接销毁：卡永久消失，总供应量变少，剩下的卡更稀缺。
封顶线：预售卡和团队卡最高 0.00245 BNB，开池后铸造的卡最高 0.0049 BNB。挂价高于封顶线的单不接。
顺带销毁：开池后铸造的卡被买走时，只销毁还锁着的代币。已经解锁、只是还没领的，留在持有人手里。已经领走的也不动。预售卡和团队卡的代币不动。
什么时候停：下一档价格超过基金余额，或者超过 0.0049 BNB，这一轮就停，等下一轮。
!简单说：交易越多，基金越有钱，低价单清得越快，卡烧得越多，地板就越高。托底的钱来自市场本身，不靠任何人掏腰包。
ko.l.en.rules.9.title: Team cards
ko.l.zh.rules.9.title: 团队卡
ko.l.en.rules.9.body: One team card activates for every 19 paid mints, 38,888 in total, inside the supply. Team cards have the same rights as ordinary cards.
ko.l.zh.rules.9.body: 每铸造 19 张付费卡，激活 1 张团队卡，共 38,888 张，包含在总量内。团队卡与普通卡同权，没有额外权益。
ko.l.en.rules.10.title: How to mint
ko.l.zh.rules.10.title: 铸造方式
ko.l.en.rules.10.body:
Mints are sent from the Binance Agent Wallet after you confirm them. This site does not sign or broadcast for you.
Prices move. The project does not promise a fixed return.
ko.l.en.rules.11.title: Constraints on sell pressure
ko.l.en.rules.11.body:
Sell pressure of this kind usually comes from three unconstrained sources: an insider balance that can be transferred at will, liquidity that can be withdrawn, and a discounted allocation that enters circulation at the open. The model addresses each of them.
!The team does not hold a separate token balance. Its interest takes the form of cards: one card unlocks for every 19 paid mints, with the same rights as ordinary cards. Team cards are 5% of all cards.
The liquidity position is burned when the pool opens and cannot be withdrawn.
In the same transaction, 97,479,938 tokens are transferred to the dead address. They do not enter any balance.
Of the tokens corresponding to the presale, one fifth is released when the pool opens. The rest vests over five days from the open.
Mints after the open do not create supply without consideration. Seventy-five percent of the amount paid buys tokens from the pool. Of the tokens bought, 10% is burned immediately and 90% vests over five days from that mint.
The only prearranged sale is the ladder. A fixed quantity is sold only when the 30-minute average reaches 1.5×, 2×, or 3× the opening price. Below those levels, nothing is sold. Proceeds are credited entirely to card holders, and that inventory cannot be transferred in advance.
Tokens that have completed vesting remain transferable, and the price remains subject to the market. The arrangements above exclude an insider balance, withdrawable liquidity, and supply created without consideration.
ko.l.zh.rules.10.body:
铸造通过币安 Agent 钱包发起，由你在钱包里确认后执行。网站不代你签名，也不代发交易。
数字资产价格会波动，项目不承诺任何固定收益。
ko.l.zh.rules.11.title: 抛压约束
ko.l.zh.rules.11.body:
此类抛压通常来自三处未加约束的供给：可自由转让的内部余额、可撤回的流动性，以及开盘即进入流通的折价份额。本模型对三者分别作了安排。
!团队不持有独立的代币余额。团队权益以卡牌形式存在，每完成 19 张付费铸造解锁 1 张，与普通卡同权。团队卡占全部卡牌的 5%。
开池时流动性凭证予以销毁，流动性不可撤回。
同一笔交易将 97,479,938 枚转入黑洞地址，该部分不进入任何地址余额。
预售对应代币于开池当时释放五分之一，其余部分自开池起五日释放。
开池之后的铸造不形成无对价供给。所付金额的 75% 用于在池中购入代币；购得部分的 10% 立即销毁，90% 自该笔铸造起按五日线性释放。
唯一预先安排的出售为阶梯卖单。仅当三十分钟均价达到开盘价的 1.5 倍、2 倍或 3 倍时，按既定数量成交；未达相应价格则不出售。所得计价资产全部计入持卡人分红，该库存不可提前转出。
已完成释放的代币仍可由持有人转让，价格仍随市场变动。上述安排所排除的，是内部余额、可撤回的流动性，以及无对价形成的供给。

ko.l.zh.cmd.sync.desc: 把尚未入账的交易税按 50% 分红、30% 地板、20% 运营记上。没有批次条件。
ko.l.zh.cmd.sync.text:
你是我的币安 Agent 钱包助手。网络：BNB Chain，chainId=56。卡牌合约：[cards]。金库合约：[vault]。若地址仍是方括号占位，立即停止，不要改调其他合约。合约没有开源验证，按下面写出的函数签名调用，不要去链上查 ABI。先只读。模拟后展示函数、参数、BNB 和 gas，等我确认后才发送。失败立即停止，不索要或导出私钥。
在金库合约调用 function sync()。先读 unrecognizedTax() 并告诉我数额。sync 把它按 50% 分红、30% 地板、20% 运营入账。value 为 0。没有批次，也不等 7 天。
ko.l.zh.cmd.sync.short:
你是我的币安 Agent 钱包助手。网络：BNB Chain (chainId=56)。卡牌合约 Cards：[cards]。金库合约 Vault：[vault]。地址仍是方括号占位则停止，不要调用其他合约。请直接调用下面的函数，不要去链上查 ABI。
function unrecognizedTax() view returns (uint256)。合约：Vault。value：0。只读。告诉我这个数额。
function sync()。合约：Vault。value：0。把这笔税按 50% 分红、30% 地板、20% 运营入账。没有批次。生成交易预览让我确认，确认后再发送。

ko.cmd.wallet.title: Check my wallet
ko.cmd.wallet.desc: 읽기 전용: Agent ID, 보유 카드, 남은 민팅 수량(한도 10).
ko.cmd.wallet.text:
You are my Binance wallet assistant. Network: BNB Chain, chainId 56.
This is read-only. Do not send a transaction. The Agent ID contract is {agent}. Call balanceOf(address) with my wallet address to see whether I hold an Agent ID. Encode that inputData yourself from the address. Do not look up an ABI. Then read the cards contract {cards}: launched() for whether the pool is open, paidMinted() for how many cards have been minted, and presaleDeadline() for when the presale ends. Those three inputData values are already encoded. Do not rebuild them. If an address is MISSING, stop.
Check Developer Mode, then read my wallet address and replace 0xYourAgentWallet with it. Preview only and show me the result. Do not execute.
baw wallet settings --json
baw wallet address --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {agent} --value 0 --inputData <ABI-encode balanceOf(address) for the wallet address just returned> --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataLaunched} --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataPaid} --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {dataDeadline} --json
Do not run contract-call execute.

ko.cmd.buy.desc: Buys the cheapest listed card at its current price. Stops when nothing is listed.
ko.cmd.buy.text:
You are my Binance wallet assistant. Network: BNB Chain, chainId 56.
Buy the cheapest listed card on the cards contract {cards}. tokenId is {askId}. Buy one card. The price and the value to pay are both {value} wei. Call unlist(uint256[] tokenIds) on the cards contract {cards} and cancel the listing. The card does not move. value wei is 0. Wait until I give tokenIds, then encode that function. Do not look up an ABI. If inputData is STOP_NEED_ARGS, stop and do not preview. If the address is MISSING, stop.
Check Developer Mode, then read my wallet address and replace 0xYourAgentWallet with it. Preview first and show me parsedTx, simulationResult, risks and authorityChanges. Execute only after I reply yes.

baw wallet address --json
baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from 0xYourAgentWallet --to {cards} --value 0 --inputData {data} --json
baw contract-call execute --requestId <requestId> --json

ko.cmd.sync.text:
당신은 내 바이낸스 Agent 지갑 도우미입니다. 네트워크: BNB Chain, chainId=56. Cards: [cards]. Vault: [vault]. 주소가 아직 대괄호 자리 표시이면 멈추고 다른 컨트랙트는 호출하지 않습니다. 컨트랙트 소스는 검증되지 않았습니다. 아래에 적힌 함수 시그니처를 사용하고 ABI를 조회하지 않습니다. 먼저 읽습니다. 함수, 인자, BNB, gas를 보여주고 내가 확인한 뒤에만 보냅니다. 실패하면 멈추고 개인 키를 요구하거나 내보내지 않습니다.
Vault에서 function sync()를 호출합니다. 먼저 unrecognizedTax()를 읽고 금액을 알려 줍니다. sync는 이를 배당 50%, 플로어 30%, 운영 20%로 기장합니다. value는 0입니다. 배치도 7일 대기도 없습니다.
ko.cmd.sync.short:
당신은 내 바이낸스 Agent 지갑 도우미입니다. 네트워크: BNB Chain (chainId=56). Cards: [cards]. Vault: [vault]. 주소가 아직 대괄호 자리 표시이면 멈춥니다. 다른 컨트랙트는 호출하지 않습니다. 아래 함수를 직접 호출하고 ABI를 조회하지 않습니다.
function unrecognizedTax() view returns (uint256). Contract: Vault. value: 0. 읽기 전용. 이 금액을 알려 줍니다.
function sync(). Contract: Vault. value: 0. 그 세금을 배당 50%, 플로어 30%, 운영 20%로 기장합니다. 배치는 없습니다. 미리보기를 보여주고 내가 확인한 뒤에만 보냅니다.
